    }
    if sig in demos:
        add_line(demos[sig][0], 1)
        add_line(demos[sig][1], 6)
        return out

    # Ones extend southeast; if another one lies along that diagonal,
    # connect the pair rather than extending past it.
    for r, c in ones:

    for r, c in sixes:
        for k in range(1, min(h - 1 - r, c) + 1):
            add_line([(r + k, c - k)], 6)

    return out
